versions.changelog:
feedship 1.5.0

- Added info command to display system configuration, storage, and version info.
- New --json output option for feed list, article list, search, discover, and info commands.
- OpenClaw cron integration: default scheduled article fetching every 30 minutes.
- Setup instructions now favor uv tool installation; pipx instruction removed.
- Documentation improvements for automation and scheduler usage (macOS, Linux, Cron, OpenClaw).
- Various options clarified in command descriptions and usage examples.

- Added guidance for using PyPI and HuggingFace mirrors (Aliyun, hf-mirror) in restricted networks.
- Updated setup instructions to include persistent environment variable export for both HF_ENDPOINT and PIP_INDEX_URL.
- Added upgrade instructions, including options for upgrading directly from GitHub.
- No changes to commands or usage; documentation improvements only.

- Installation instructions updated: pipx with extras ([cloudflare,ml]) is now the recommended method, with uv as an alternative.
- Added notes about the purpose and requirement of the [cloudflare] and [ml] extras for full functionality.
- Included HuggingFace mirror setup guidance for restricted networks.
- Clarified first-time semantic search setup requirements in the documentation.
- No command or functionality changes; documentation improvements only.

Feedship 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Manage RSS/Atom feeds: add, list, remove subscriptions.
- Fetch articles from subscribed feeds and manage or view article content.
- Search articles using full-text or semantic (vector) search.
- Discover feeds on websites without subscribing.
- Outputs presented as Rich tables, panels, and progress bars for enhanced UX.
- Optional ML and Cloudflare extras for semantic features and advanced scraping.
